description: This file defines a PHP script for rendering the SubPanel view of Opportunities related to Projects within the SuiteCRM system. It sets up UI elements such as a popup button for selecting opportunities, handles localization for different languages, and initializes a list view with templates and layout controls.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM system, with methods for initializing templates, assigning variables, and processing data for display.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView object with a specific HTML template and localization strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the HTML template for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the list view header.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the HTML content for the list view header.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data.
